text:
maya: Heads-up — p99 token latency in west2 creeping up since ~10:20 UTC, visible on the TTFT dashboard.
jordan: saw that too. p99 went from ~320ms -> ~680ms over 30m.
maya: grafana: https://grafana.redwood-internal.com/d/abcd/ttft-overview?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now
priya: any obvious network egress errors in logs for west2?
sam: checking logs now, grep shows repeated connection reset to redis-proxy-1 in west2: ``connection reset by peer`` around same timeframe
maya: Prom query I used for p99 (per-region):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))
```
maya: tokens/sec in west2 also dipped ~12% around the same time: ``sum(rate(redwood_tokens_served_total[5m])) by (region)``
jordan: oncall-bot fired at 1745611800 for token_slo_p99_west2_high
oncall-bot: Alert: token_slo_p99_west2_high — p99 > 600ms (5m avg). Triggered at 1745611800. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/ttft-p99
priya: quick triage: is this noisy (brief spike) or sustained? we should avoid paging unless sustained >10m
maya: spike has been intermittent but recurring every ~8-12m window for last 45m
sam: hypothesis: a noisy KV cache pod restarted causing cold KV misses -> higher inference prep time
jordan: I can see a restart on kv-cache-west2-3 at 1745611505, kube-events show OOMKilled
maya: OOMKilled — that fits. when kv pod restarts we lose local KV prefix cache, causes backpressure on token path
priya: proposed actions:
- increase alert smoothing: change alert eval to 15m for west2 p99 to reduce flapping
- add a severity threshold: only page when sustained > 600ms for 15m and tokens/sec drop > 10%
- add synthetic probe that hits small prompt endpoint from west2 every 30s to detect regional degradation earlier
jordan: suggested new Prom rule for paging:
```
alert: token_slo_p99_west2_sustained
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region)) > 0.6 and
      (sum(rate(redwood_tokens_served_total[15m])) by (region) < (sum(rate(redwood_tokens_served_total[15m])) by (region) * 0.9))
for: 15m
labels:
  severity: page
```
maya: small tweak: compare to historical baseline makes expr clunky. prefer: p99 > 0.6 and decrease tokens/sec by >10% vs 1h ago. But ok as a short-term change.
priya: I'll file a dashboard PR to add a west2-specific panel for kv-restarts and node memory pressure + link to the synthetic probe results
sam: can we add a Grafana alert annotation and dashboard note pointing to the runbook? helps oncall
maya: Agree. Also add an autoscale tweak: keep one spare kv-cache pod per node pool to reduce OOM pressure during GC storms.
jordan: I'll reopen the node's instance type ticket: west2 smaller SKU has less memory, might need a diff SKU for kv pods
priya: I created a lite BG job for synthetic probes (canary-probe-west2) in k8s: image=redwood/canary:latest, schedule=@every 30s, probes=5 threads. logs go to /canary/west2.
priya: probe sample output in logs:
```
[2024-05-22T10:25:00Z] ok latency=120ms p99=120ms
[2024-05-22T10:25:30Z] fail connect=ECONNRESET
```
jordan: good. we should wire probe metrics into Prom: redwood_canary_probe_failures_total{region="west2"} and redwood_canary_probe_latency_seconds
maya: I'll take ownership of the alert config PR (grafana/alerts repo). Planning to set 15m window and add the tokens/sec suppression condition. Target to merge by EOD.
sam: ops play: restart kv-cache-west2-3 to try to recover now or wait for autoscale? it's already restarted once and OOM is recurring
priya: don't restart again until we increase resource limits or force a node drain to move pods to larger nodes
maya: I opened a perf-ticket #INF-487 to track node sizing + autoscale policy change
oncall-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by @maya. Paging paused for 30m while team investigates.
jordan: quick checklist for merge:
- update alert expr
- add annotation with runbook link
- create grafana panel for canary metrics
- add dashboard link to incident channel
maya: I'll tag the PR in #eng-releases once ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
sam: will monitor logs and post if OOM recurs
priya: follow-up: I'll add a CI step to fail if kv pod memory usage > 85% for >10m in canary cluster
maya: wrap-up: immediate mitigations in progress, long-term: node SKU increase + autoscale policy + prefix cache persistence work. Will sync in weekly infra review.
